name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: Adopt Keychron K4’s dark grey background for the AI website. It signals tech sophistication and focus, which aligns with AI’s precision and seriousness. The trade-off is losing playful energy, but clarity and professionalism outweigh that for a technical product.

name: Squint
text: Dark grey risks making AI feel cold and corporate—like a bank’s website—when warmth builds trust. A better alternative: use Keychron’s dark grey *only* for the header/footer, then shift to a muted teal gradient in the body to balance sophistication with approachability. Settle it by A/B testing both versions with users who’ve never heard of Eitan’s picks.
